page.overview:
What is Adder Swamp?

The Adder Swamp, sometimes spelled Adderswamp, was a dangerous expanse of lycanthrope-infested marshland that surrounded the Adder River delta in Chessenta.

The swamp was murky and infested with insects and vermin. Like the Adder River, the Adder Swamp was known for its large snake population. It was also one of the few rare places along the entire coast of Chessenta where sailors would not moor their boats.

It was a salt marsh notable for its production of salt.

Following the Spellplague and the various catastrophes that befell Chessenta, the Adder Swamp greatly expanded to cover much of the western coast of the Bay of Chessenta.
